notes.title: Noon, somewhere in the Caribbean
notes.notes:
Yo Ho Ho!

Ahoy ‘n avast ye, landlubbers 'n old salts! Today be the official Talk Like a Pirate Day. 

Stick t' it, unpack yer finest pirate-speak 'n ye won't be keelhauled, arrr!

But we still wants t' tell ye about the fat booty we made when we shot this two-master ripe fer plunder wit' three salvos on our way t' Nassau. So perk up yer eavesdroppers, aye!

Thar was plenty o' rum 'n gunpowder on that ship, which honourable pirates could ne'er refuse. 

So thank ye, nameless cap'n we sent t' bathe in the soft purrin' waters o' the Caribbean, ye son of a biscuit eater. In the cap'n's cabin we found a natterin' parrot who chattered somethin' about "booty map" all the time 'n. Shiver me timbers, we widened our eyes when we found this map on the mess table. Best o' all, the booty was only half a day's journey away on a wee chunk here in the Caribbean.

So we handsomely loaded everythin' up, added Parrot t' the crew 'n smartly sailed t' this rock.  'n wha' did we find thar, arrr? A wee box wit' many o’ pieces o’ eight 'n a document in which a nobleman complained about how pirates could dare t' declare a pirate republic! 

Honestly, wha' could be better than followin' the pirate code 'n livin' in a pirate republic, aye? Let this be our new name from now on: Pirates Republic!

Savvy?

notes.title: Pirate’s Dynasty: Riches and booty ahead!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43359729/ccf9d0d419c01d92f576f0c1390c71587e696713.png[/img]

Yarrr, Mateys!

Do you hear it? How the enemies fire their cannons at your ship? Do you feel it? The impact of the cannonball and the cold merciless sea rising, dragging your ship relentlessly into the dark deep?

You see your life and dreams passing by! The dream of your own pirate ship, your own crew and the joyous freedom of sailing and ruling the seven seas haunts you!
Live your dream – as a buccaneer in Pirate’s Dynasty and create your own pirates’ nest, fight and defend your possessions, while you secure your entry in the history books of this world for you and your crew!  

Developer Golden Hind Games and Publisher Toplitz Productions proudly announce Pirate’s Dynasty. In the coming weeks and months, we will give you plenty of information about the newest entry in the Dynasty franchise. You can look forward to exciting cooperative sea battles in a huge, procedurally generated world and more loot than you can store in your treasure chests.

Let us know in the comments, how you imagine your life as a pirate and stay tuned. Further news will be pinned to the mast soon.
